content.thinking:
The brute force explodes even for small R because routes can generate many runs (routes with random lengths create up to 2n+1 runs; n up to 5 initial + changes → R up to ~15, and brute over R=15 is astronomically large). I need to cap R in the fuzz cases to ~4-5. Let me restrict the generator: accept a case only if all versions have R <= 4 (or 5). Let me modify build_request's filter: skip case if any version R > 4. And keep options small.

Also `max_options` check happens after generation — too late (memory blowup during gen). Add R cap in build_request.
